'''Warthan's Wizards''' were a secret group of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designers and [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] active by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE" /> considered the finest technicians in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="ROTS ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> They were first hired by then-[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to upgrade his personal [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]] with a [[hyperwave reflector]]<ref name="ROTS ICS" /> and receiver rig<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|thetaclassshuttle|Imperial ''Theta''-class shuttle}}</ref> akin to secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing devices]]<ref name="ROTS ICS" /> that extended the ship's comms range to encompass nearly the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="S&V 63 Action Stations">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|63|Action Stations}}</ref> and provided near-instant communications.<ref name="ROTS ICS" /> Warthan's Wizards then installed a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] masking system that rendered the inside of the main body of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] undetectable by scanners, useful for Palpatine due to his secret identity as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious.<ref name="S&V 63 Action Stations" /> In order to perform these modifications, Warthan's Wizards ripped out the shuttle's modest decor to make way for harsh and sinister lodgings at the dictation of Palpatine.<ref name="S&V 63 In Command">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|63|In Command}}</ref>

In the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Warthan's Wizards were an important part of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] new technology development system,<ref name="S&V 63 Action Stations" /> coming up with some of the Empire's most confidential starship designs.<ref name="CSWE" /> During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] examined a hypercomm device possibly made back in the days of Warthan's Wizards and [[Section 19]].<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
